title: Block-Sparse Gauss-Newton Optimization of Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Sparse Automatic Differentiation Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.13231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we develop an efficient Gauss-Newton optimization approach for finite basis physics-informed neural networks (FBPINNs). The key ingredient is the overlapping domain decomposition architecture of FBPINNs, which localizes the influence of each subnetwork and induces block sparsity in both the residual Jacobian and the corresponding Gauss-Newton matrix. We characterize this structure and exploit it through sparse automatic differentiation, using graph coloring to partition structurally orthogonal Jacobian columns or rows. This reduces differentiation costs and memory requirements while preserving all structurally nonzero derivative information. The resulting compressed Jacobian representations allow us to assemble the Gauss-Newton system directly in block-sparse form, enabling the use of sparse direct solvers and preconditioned iterative methods. translated_title: 有限基物理信息神经网络的块稀疏高斯-牛顿优化：稀疏自动微分方法
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们为有限基物理信息神经网络开发了一种高效的高斯-牛顿优化方法。其关键要素在于FBPINNs的重叠域分解架构，该架构将每个子网络的影响局部化，从而在残差雅可比矩阵和相应的高斯-牛顿矩阵中诱导出块稀疏性。我们对这种结构进行了刻画，并通过稀疏自动微分加以利用，采用图着色技术对结构上正交的雅可比列或行进行划分。这降低了微分计算成本和内存需求，同时保留了所有结构上非零的导数信息。由此得到的压缩雅可比表示使我们能够直接以块稀疏形式组装高斯-牛顿系统，从而可以使用稀疏直接求解器和预处理迭代方法。通过这种方式，原本计算代价高昂的二阶优化问题得以缩减。
tldr: 本文利用FBPINNs重叠域分解架构所诱导的雅可比矩阵块稀疏性，结合基于图着色的稀疏自动微分技术，实现了高效的高斯-牛顿二阶优化，大幅降低了计算成本与内存需求。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits the block sparsity in the Jacobian induced by FBPINNs' overlapping domain decomposition architecture using graph-coloring-based sparse automatic differentiation, enabling efficient Gauss-Newton second-order optimization with significantly reduced computational and memory costs.
